name: FIGS, Inc.

catalysts.headline: Shares rose on an industry/sector review piece re-highlighting FIGS as the top performer among consumer-discretionary apparel peers on its already-reported Q2 FY2026 beat; move size reported inconsistently (5.5% to 13%) across outlets

Q2 FY2026 results: revenue $196.6M (+28.8% YoY, beat $186M est. by ~5.6%); EPS $0.15 vs $0.07 est.; raised FY2026 revenue-growth guidance to ~20% (from 14-16%); adjusted EBITDA margin guidance set at 14.8-15.0%; buyback authorization increased by $100M to $200M total
Added to the Russell 2000 Growth-Defensive Index and the Russell 2000 Defensive Index
Q1 FY2026 results: revenue $159.90M (+28.0% YoY, beat $153.15M est.); adjusted EPS $0.03 vs $0.01 est.; initial FY2026 guidance set at 14-16% revenue growth (later raised in August)
